text:
Mina J: heads-up: all-hands Thursday 10:30am PT. short agenda: 1) exec highlights + hiring snapshot (8m) 2) operational playbook: new hosted data-handling defaults + Console "data policy mode" (12m) 3) Dedicated rollout callouts + migration office-hours (10m) 4) live Q&A + 3-min engineer takeaways. drop Qs here. :mega:
Carlos R: will the "data policy mode" be a global toggle or per-tenant?
Priya K: per-tenant. Console will expose a dropdown: "redact | hash | preserve". default for Hosted prod moves to 120-day rolling logs with identifier-hashing enabled by default.
Sam T: nice. any SDK changes devs should expect?
Priya K: minimal. we'll ship client-side helpers in Go/Python/JS to compute the hash and headers to opt-out. example header: ```
X-RW-Data-Policy: hash
```
Lara N: can we see a short code sample for Go in the all-hands deck? I manage a few infra repos.
Priya K: yes — we'll include a 3-line Go snippet and a full example in the follow-up doc. snippet to include: ```go
req.Header.Set("X-RW-Data-Policy", "hash")
```
Mina J: ops note: Dedicated tenants retain current settings unless tenant admin chooses "migrate to defaults". we'll run two migration office-hours next week Mon/Wed 2-4pm PT for hands-on help.
Carlos R: timeline for hosted rollout? staged or immediate?
Priya K: staged. Hosted rollout schedule: pilot (week 0) -> 7-day gradual ramp (week 1) -> enforcement at day 14. checkpoints at day 2 and day 9 with health checks.
Sam T: any impact to alerts/observability? I want to make sure incident triage still has what it needs.
Lara N: security chiming in: hashed identifiers preserve ability to correlate events while removing cleartext PII. alert metadata preserved; payload snippets will be hashed. we'll show example of what still appears in alerts.
Mina J: customer comms: we'll run a 30/10/3-day notification cadence and publish a ready-to-send customer email template in /docs/announcements. we'll also post a short one-paragraph blurb ops can paste.
Carlos R: billing question: does longer retention change cost for Hosted?
Priya K: short answer: no change for up to 120 days. anything beyond 120d is a billable archive add-on; we'll include concrete cost examples on the slide.
Sam T: accessibility: please enable live captions and post transcript + timestamped deck after. some folks need the transcript.
RecordingBot: I'll upload the recording + transcript to internal drive and post links here within ~1 hour after the meeting. captions enabled.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled \u2014 All-Hands Thu 10:30am PT \u2014 reminders in 24h and 30m.
Lara N: for the Q&A, adding: will analytics exports (aggregated metrics) be affected if we hash identifiers?
Priya K: aggregated metrics unaffected. export of raw logs follows retention and policy choice; we'll show the export exceptions slide.
Mina J: quick ask for eng leads: can product include a "What to do" two-bullet slide we can forward? makes team rollouts smoother.
Priya K: yes — final slide will have a 2-bullet checklist.
Sam T: can we also get a short runbook for rolling back the console toggle if we see regressions?
Mina J: ops will attach an A/B rollback playbook and a short rollback CLI in the follow-up docs. office-hours will walk through it.
Carlos R: small ask: include a sample customer-facing FAQ snippet for support teams.
Mina J: done — customer FAQ + customer-facing one-paragraph blurb will be in the post-meeting package.
Priya K: thanks all. drop any last Qs here and we'll triage into the live Q&A. see you Thu. :thumbsup:

What engineers should do (two bullets we will share):
- Verify SDKs handle X-RW-Data-Policy header and update ingestion clients if you compute identifiers locally.
- If you manage Dedicated tenants, schedule migration during the office-hours slot or test in staging before toggling.
